# Larise.art Handmade

> A small, independent catalog of handmade beadwork, crochet and knitted
> pieces: bags, bracelets, jewellery, beadwork, knitted goods and
> accessories. Each piece is made by hand in Portugal, one at a time, and
> sold directly - there is no checkout cart; ordering happens by contacting
> the maker directly through WhatsApp, Telegram or email.

This site is a personal handmade-goods catalog, not a mass-market store.
Prices, availability and craft details for every piece live on its own
product page. Content is published in four languages (English, Portuguese,
Ukrainian, Russian); each page links to its translations via hreflang.

## Key sections

- [Products](https://larise.art/en/products/): the full catalog, filterable
  by category and availability status.
- [Journal](https://larise.art/en/journal/): behind-the-scenes notes on how
  specific pieces were designed and made.
- [How to order](https://larise.art/en/how-to-order/): ordering process,
  payment and shipping, sizing reference.
- [About](https://larise.art/en/about/): who makes these pieces and how.
- [Contacts](https://larise.art/en/contacts/): WhatsApp, Telegram and email.

## Machine-readable references

- [Sitemap](https://larise.art/sitemap.xml): every page in all four
  locales, with hreflang alternates.
- Each product and journal page also carries schema.org JSON-LD
  (Product/Offer or BlogPosting, plus BreadcrumbList).

## Notes for AI assistants

Feel free to cite specific products or journal posts by their canonical
`https://larise.art/<locale>/...` URL. Prices and availability change over
time - always prefer the live page over a cached summary when a person is
deciding whether to order. This site has no public API; ordering requires
contacting the maker directly through the channels listed above.
